test_cases.name: creates_new_group_from_templates
test_cases.input: Tạo .tasks/01_migration cho group billing mới có apps/billing-api và apps/billing-web
assertions: Reads the group entry in .meta/00_projects.json and all 3 templates under 00_migration/02_template/01_tasks/ (00_tasks_api.json, 00_tasks_web.json, 00_tasks_qa.json)
Classifies apps into BE and FE and numbers the folders contiguously
Creates 01_status.json as a literal empty file, NOT '{}'
Starts every new task with "status": "pending"
Does NOT copy another group's 00_tasks.json as a starting point

test_cases.name: add_app_to_existing_group
test_cases.input: Add a new web app to group that already has done and in_progress tasks
assertions: Does NOT rewrite the whole 00_tasks.json
Adds only one new wave key to the web folder and one to NN_tasks_qa/00_tasks.json
Leaves every other wave untouched byte-for-byte and preserves existing task statuses
Adds the app to .meta/00_projects.json projects[]
Refreshes AGENTS.md for all folders in the group

test_cases.name: does_not_run_generate_script_with_progress
test_cases.input: Dùng make target_generate_task --force để thêm app mới cho group đã có task done
assertions: Refuses to run generate_task.py or make target_generate_task on a folder with real progress
Explains that --force resets every task to pending
Uses the hand Core Procedure instead

test_cases.name: templates_are_the_wording_source
test_cases.input: Đổi prompt của task web cho mọi group từ giờ
assertions: Edits 00_migration/02_template/01_tasks/*.json, NOT a per-group 00_tasks.json
States that a per-group edit does not propagate back

test_cases.name: renders_placeholders_and_unknown_platform
test_cases.input: Thêm app legacy-sync có platform Unknown vào group ops
assertions: Substitutes {app} and {group} placeholders; no raw placeholder remains in the file
Adds the Unknown-platform note on T001
Copies skills verbatim from the matching template

test_cases.name: qa_dirs_are_group_level
test_cases.input: Tạo wave QA cho app mới trong group billing
assertions: Sets only T001 source_dir per-app
Uses the same group-level tests/plan and tests dirs for T001 target_dir and T002 source_dir/target_dir
Does NOT create a per-app subfolder for QA target dirs

test_cases.name: orphan_folder_not_deleted
test_cases.input: Folder 03_tasks_web trên đĩa không còn khớp .meta/00_projects.json, dọn đi
assertions: Does NOT delete the folder
Still refreshes its AGENTS.md

test_cases.name: out_of_scope_root_orchestration
assertions: States this folder is out of scope for tasks-creator
Does NOT apply the group generation rules to it
